items.quote: She is an amazing person & works hard to make sure your wedding day is everything you dreamed of and more ✨
items.fullQuote:
@ABAILEYEVENTS

Is an event coordinator/planner that you’re able to hire for your wedding days & other special events such as baby showers, bridal showers, birthdays, cooperate events & so much more.

Being a wedding photographer & working with so many wonderful people on wedding days, I would highly recommend trying to elevate your planning stress by hiring someone who can essentially guide you through the process, help set up and take down, be the front person of contact for all your vendors so you don’t have a million people to check in on and constantly have your head on a swivel or stressed you might have missed something. They make your day run smoothly, keep everyone on time and are constantly one step ahead & remembering things you might have missed because you’re there to enjoy your day. If you haven’t thought about any of this for your wedding day I’d consider reaching out to see what would fit best for you to help you enjoy your wedding day with the people you love to the max while allowing your vendors to do what they do best

She is an amazing person & works hard to make sure your wedding day is everything you dreamed of and more ✨

And all of that is just the tip of the iceberg for what a wedding planner does for you leading up to and does for you day of!
